scripts.test:macos: xcodegen generate --spec apps/macos/project.yml && CLUMSIES_SKIP_DAEMON_BUILD=1 xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/macos/Clumsies.xcodeproj -scheme Clumsies -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/clumsies-macos-tests test
scripts.test:macos:live: xcodegen generate --spec apps/macos/project.yml && CLUMSIES_SKIP_DAEMON_BUILD=1 xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/macos/Clumsies.xcodeproj -scheme ClumsiesLiveTests -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/clumsies-macos-live-tests test
